parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift. The two methods — fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnDecodingError (line 84) and fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnCancellationError (line 103) — are distinct test cases that verify different error-path behaviours (decoding failure vs. cancellation); their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.73) reflects the shared arrange-act-assert skeleton common to all error-path tests, not accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the specific failure scenario each test is meant to document and would couple unrelated error semantics under a single test body.
